Silver Finger Ring. Cast band tapering gently to an oval bezel bearing an inscribed star or flower motif of nine or more points. The ends of the band probably met at their narrowest point opposite the bezel, and are at all events now separate.Suggested date: Possibly Roman. In view of the suspected material and age, this object is to be submitted to the Treasure process, reference 2013 T418.…
